name: Alfadolone
summary: Alfadolone (INN), or alphadolone is a neuroactive steroid and general anesthetic. Along with alfaxolone, as alfadolone acetate, it is one of the components of the anesthetic drug mixture althesin.

uses.text: Alfadolone (INN), or alphadolone is a neuroactive steroid and general anesthetic. Along with alfaxolone, as alfadolone acetate, it is one of the components of the anesthetic drug mixture althesin.

summaryZh: 阿法多龍是一種具有神經活性的類固醇和全身麻醉劑。它以乙酸阿法多龍的形式與阿法沙龍一起作為麻醉藥物混合物阿法沙龍/阿法多龍的成分之一。

pharmacology.en: As a neuroactive steroid, it strengthens the effect of GABA at the GABA-A receptor, the brain's main calming signal. This slows brain activity and can cause sedation and anaesthesia.
pharmacology.zh: 作為神經活性類固醇，阿法多龍會增強 GABA 在 GABA-A 受體上的作用，也就是大腦主要的抑制訊號，從而減緩腦部活動，造成鎮靜與麻醉。
pharmacology.zhHans: 作为神经活性类固醇，阿法多龙会增强 GABA 在 GABA-A 受体上的作用，也就是大脑主要的抑制信号，从而减缓脑部活动，造成镇静与麻醉。

sideEffects.en: As part of Althesin it was linked to severe allergic reactions, mostly blamed on the solvent. Like other anaesthetics, it can slow breathing and lower blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 作為 Althesin 的成分，它曾與嚴重過敏反應有關，但多半歸咎於溶劑。和其他麻醉藥一樣，它可能使呼吸變慢並降低血壓。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为 Althesin 的成分，它曾与严重过敏反应有关，但多半归咎于溶剂。和其他麻醉药一样，它可能使呼吸变慢并降低血压。

fact.en: It was one half of Althesin, an injected anaesthetic of the 1970s. Althesin was withdrawn because the castor oil based solvent it was dissolved in caused severe allergic reactions.
fact.zh: 阿法多龍是 1970 年代注射型麻醉藥 Althesin 的兩種成分之一。Althesin 後來下市，原因是用來溶解它的蓖麻油類溶劑會引起嚴重過敏反應。
fact.zhHans: 阿法多龙是 1970 年代注射型麻醉药 Althesin 的两种成分之一。Althesin 后来下市，原因是用来溶解它的蓖麻油类溶剂会引起严重过敏反应。
